title: hono: a `409 CONCURRENT_UPDATE` rendered by #16545's recogniser (`createHonoApp`, the direct-mount adapter) carries no `currentVersion` or `currentRecord`, which the wire contract and objectui's conflict bar read
body:
Filing gate **①**, class **(b)**: a door's answer omits fields its declared wire contract names. It was measured at a public door.

`reach:` measured by #23365's dev (`os-dev-report` `6176061093`, out-of-scope finding 1). The setup was a real `@objectstack/hono` `createHonoApp` over the real dispatcher and protocol, in PR #23530's conformance rig, at `167cebe824` and later. Before PR #23530 the same request answered `500`.
- `PATCH` and `DELETE /api/v1/data/task/ID` with a stale `If-Match` answer `409 {"success":false,"error":{"code":"CONCURRENT_UPDATE","message":"Record task/ID was modified by another user (current version T1, expected T0)"}}`.
- The body has no `currentVersion` and no `currentRecord`.
- The standalone REST server's `409` carries both, from `packages/types/src/data-error-classification.ts`'s `CONCURRENT_UPDATE` arm.

Filed by `domain:cli` seat 2 (#22648) · `sunhaolin` · session `session_01Q9PZ5Pzqcus4woVvTZwWNU`, at PR #23530's ACCEPT. ⛔ Not a claim. Lane and grade are triage's.

**Reader who acts:** triage grades it. The landing is `declaredEnvelopeForThrow` in `packages/plugins/plugin-hono-server/src/adapter.ts`, exported by PR #23530. It forwards only the `details` that `resolveThrownHttpError` derives, while `currentVersion` and `currentRecord` are own properties of `ConcurrentUpdateError`. It is reached by `createHonoApp`'s catch arms (after PR #23530) and by the direct-mount adapter's `wrap`/`onError`. That package is `domain:cli` by the lane table.

## Governing text

- `content/docs/api/wire-format.mdx`, section "Concurrent Update — 409 Conflict", carries `currentVersion`.
- `ConcurrentUpdateError`'s docblock (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`) says the HTTP layer "includes both the current server-side version and the current record payload".
- **Renderer that reads them:** objectui `packages/plugin-detail/src/InlineEditSaveBar.tsx:292`-`:301` reads `err.currentRecord` and `err.currentVersion`.

`Seam: contract: wire-format.mdx 409 CONCURRENT_UPDATE + ConcurrentUpdateError.currentVersion/currentRecord → runtime: plugin-hono-server declaredEnvelopeForThrow (createHonoApp thrownJson, HonoHttpServer wrap/onError) | renderer: objectui InlineEditSaveBar`.

## Acceptance (a proposal; triage's call)

- A `409 CONCURRENT_UPDATE` answered by either Hono door carries `currentVersion` and `currentRecord` as the REST door does.
- Reuse the one classification `RestServer` already applies. ⛔ No third spelling of the conflict body.
- Pins: a stale `If-Match` `PATCH` and `DELETE` through `createHonoApp` and through a direct-mount route each carry both fields.
- **Order:** after PR #23530 lands. It exports and wires the recogniser this edits.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack, closed included: `409 CONCURRENT_UPDATE body missing currentVersion currentRecord createHonoApp declaredEnvelopeForThrow conflict body`. It returned 1 hit: #22222 (closed), the `/meta` door's `409 METADATA_CONFLICT`, which named the version only in prose. That is a different code and a different producer.

Dedupe words: CONCURRENT_UPDATE currentVersion currentRecord 409 createHonoApp declaredEnvelopeForThrow conflict body.
